records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales decreased slightly in the second quarter and were flat in the first six months of fiscal 2024 as decreased sales in our Chicken and Prepared Foods segments were largely offset by increased sales in our Beef and Pork segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales Volume – Sales were negatively impacted by a decrease in sales volume, which accounted for a $193 million decrease in sales driven by decreased sales volume in our Chicken segment, partially offset by increased sales volume in our Beef, Pork and Prepared Foods segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •An increase of $277 million due to a decrease in inventory of $272 million in the first six months of fiscal 2024, compared to an increase of $5 million in the first six months of fiscal 2023, primarily driven by decreased average cost of inventory and lower volume of livestock.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our total operating margin was 2.4% in the second quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We recorded operating income of $312 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2024 as compared to an operating loss of $49 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2023 as we experienced higher operating income in our Chicken and Pork segments, partially offset by lower operating income in our Beef and Prepared Foods segments.
